item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.10)] A look at HTTP's new QUERY method
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.10)

This method provides a safe and idempotent alternative to GET and POST for queries, carrying content in the request body without altering server state. It offers greater reliability, observability, and compliance for repeatable queries, addressing limitations of traditional methods like URL size constraints and operational ambiguity.
